column2: a fireball flying down to the lower-left: a big round ball in the lower-left, with a thick flame tail of three chunky rounded tongues sweeping back toward the upper-right. Two small round craters are cut out of the ball.
a six-armed snowflake: six thick rounded arms meeting in the centre, each arm with one pair of short rounded branches near its tip. Perfectly symmetric.

a spear on a 45 degree diagonal pointing to the upper-right: a broad leaf-shaped blade at the upper-right, a short thick crossguard just below the blade, and a thick straight shaft running down to the lower-left with a rounded end.
a clock that is rushing: a thick circular ring with two thick clock hands inside it, and three short thick horizontal speed dashes of different lengths trailing off its left side.

an upward-pointing arrowhead (a triangle with a notch cut into its base, like a paper plane seen from above) with a pair of chunky wings, one spread to the left and one to the right, each wing made of three rounded feathers.

a jagged fissure torn open: a wide horizontal tear, pointed at both ends and widest in the middle, with sharp zigzag edges. It is drawn as a thick white jagged band around an empty black inside. Three small angular shards float just above it.
a heater shield being eaten away by acid: a big bite is missing from its upper-right edge, three round holes of different sizes are eaten through it, and two thick droplets fall from its lower edge.

a sheet of seven different emblems arranged in a tidy grid of four on the top row and three on the bottom row, all in exactly the same style and the same visual weight: 1) a fireball with a three-tongue flame tail, 2) a six-armed snowflake, 3) a diagonal spear with a leaf blade, 4) a rushing clock with speed dashes, 5) an arrowhead with two wings, 6) a jagged horizontal fissure, 7) a shield with holes eaten through it and drips.
